race.description: O'donnells Transport Lakes Entrance Cup 20/09 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: MY CHINA PLATE (10) impressed when successful as favourite on debut over 1000m at this track three weeks ago. Promising type who can go back-to-back. DISMANTLE (7) got well back over 1100m at Bendigo last time and never threatened, eventually finishing 9 lengths away in 12th. Was good the start prior and finds a suitable assignment to get back on track. I'M SAVVY AS (1) resumes off a couple of moderate trials and has a lot of weight but put three good runs together last prep, so might just be a raceday horse. EYE SUCCEED (11) ran her best race in ages last start, which was here, so her obvious liking for the track has her in it.
